Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

rprime 0.1.4

  • example_eprime_file() provides filepaths to bundled example files by short name or full filename. Call it without arguments to list available files.
  • filter_in(), filter_out(), keep_levels(), and drop_levels() now handle empty inputs, including results from earlier filters with no matches.
  • Fix a failing CRAN check following changes to str(). (#16)
  • preview_eprime(), preview_frames(), and preview_levels() now return their input invisibly, allowing previews within a data-processing pipeline.
  • to_data_frame() now has tests covering its methods, metadata, missing columns, column types, and empty inputs (#3).
  • Package upkeep. (#17)

rprime 0.1.3

CRAN release: 2025-04-25

  • Fix link in a documentation.

rprime 0.1.2

CRAN release: 2020-09-24

  • Fixed package for compatibility with stringi 1.5.3.
  • Added a NEWS.md file to track changes to the package.
